config._description: Training recipe for the BC-ResNet wakeword baseline (owner-approved plan, 2026-09-29). Keys starting with '_' are documentation.
config._label_smoothing: Binary targets become 0.025 / 0.975: tempers over-confidence on the few, single-speaker positives.
config._spec_augment: Park et al. 2019, on normalised log-mel features of training examples only. A masked region is set to 0 (the per-bin train mean). Time masks are at most 12 frames (120 ms), well under a wakeword (~0.6-1.0 s), so a positive never loses the whole word.

selection.metric: mean detection rate over positive subsets real_device_rpi and synthetic at the policy threshold

config._selection: Each epoch the model scores the frozen isolated validation set; the threshold is chosen with eval_config.json threshold_policy (per-category FPR <= 1% on deployment-like negatives), exactly as the evaluator does. Real RPI and synthetic positives are weighted equally so the device confound cannot win selection. Validation only; test and streaming are never read.
config._hard_negative_mining: Round 2: the round-1 model scores every train negative window (unaugmented); the highest-scoring 3% (at most 2,000) become a mined set that receives 10% of each epoch's draws (substituted at random positions of the bucket-quota epoch, so bucket shares shrink proportionally). Train data only; the model is retrained from scratch with the same recipe.
